rule: an uncaught error on the page
why: AN UNCAUGHT ERROR, collected by `openPage` as the page threw it. The words are the decoy alone, so the error is the one finding. The rest of the screen is the decoy every printed tree carries: a date in words, an amount, a run's handle beside its name and a person's name, none of which is a finding, so a rule that grew too wide takes the count above one.
